newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Brahma to debut on NYSE Weds.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Brahma to debut on NYSE Weds.

text.p: Brazilian brewery Brahma said it will debut on the New York Stock Exchange on Wednesday, June 4, following approval by the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) of its Level Two ADR program.
The Brahma American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) will be backed by existing shares. Each ADR will represent 20 common shares or 20 preferred stocks, the company said in a statement.
The Bank of New York will be the issuer bank abroad, while local private bank Banco Itau will be the custodian bank in Brazil, it said.
Brahma has been trading on the U.S over-the-counter market through its Level One ADRs.
Brahma will be the fifth Brazilian company to list on the New York Stock Exchange. The others are Unibanco, Pao de Acucar, Telebras and Aracruz.
